cohort: 100 pregnant women hospitalized with COVID-19 from two tertiary hospitals in southern Brazil
finding: Severe COVID-19 was the main risk factor for preeclampsia, and pregnant women with COVID-19 and preeclampsia experienced higher rates of comorbidities, prematurity, low birth weight, and neonatal intensive care admission.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was more common in the group with preeclampsia.
